rules.name: Asset Description
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The local description of the asset.

rules.name: Class
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Selected from the Master Asset Classes.

rules.name: Object Type
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Selected from the Master Asset Classes.

rules.name: Start Position
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The meterage along the corridor where the asset starts.

rules.name: End Position
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The meterage along the corridor where the asset finishes.

rules.name: Length
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The length of the asset. Does not need to be the difference between the Start and Finish KM is the asset is longer or shorter Point based Assets are 0.

rules.name: UOM
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Should always be KM

rules.name: Description KM
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The meterage the asset is known by for field wofers. This value will be used in the description of the asset. This can vary from the field position depending on the requirements of the mapping software.

rules.name: Superior FLOC / Equipment
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The parent asset that the new asset will be linked to

rules.name: Track Association
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The main location that the asset is based.

rules.name: Drawing Reference Number
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The drawing number associated to the asset.

rules.name: Connecting Infrastructure
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. If this asset is pan of the connection agreement between Queensland Rail and a Third Party.

rules.name: Local Description
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The name that the local teams know the asset by.

rules.name: Project Number
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The project that the asset was constructed / installed under.

rules.name: Maintenance Type
rules.note: Stage 1 · Data Requester · Selection Box · e.g. The type of maintenance the asset will receive. Scheduled Maintenance - This asset receives direct scheduled maintenance inspections and needs to be recognised on a maintenance plan. Associated Maintenance - This asset receives maintenance 1 inspections as par of the parent assets maintenance / inspection. It will not be recognised on a maintenance plan. Fix on Fail - This asset does not

rules.name: Inventory Number
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The inventory number associated to the asset.

rules.name: Acquisition Value
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The cost the asset was purchased too This is typically relevant for Plant Assets.

rules.name: Acquisition Date
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. When the asset was purchased.

rules.name: Manufacturer
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The manufacturer of the asset.

rules.name: Model Number
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The model number of the asset.

rules.name: Manufacturer Country
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The country the asset was manufactured in.

rules.name: Construction Year
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The year the asset was constructed in

rules.name: Construction Month
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The month the asset was constructed in.

rules.name: Manufacturer Part No
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The par number specified by the Manufacturer.

rules.name: Serial Number
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The serial number of the asset.

rules.name: Vendor
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Who the asset was purchased from.

rules.name: Location
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Where the asset is kept.

rules.name: Room
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. A search code used by Plant.

rules.name: Criticality
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Selection Box · e.g. The criticality of an asset on a scale of 1 - 5. The definitions for the scale can be sourced from GAM.

rules.name: Sort Field
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. Currently describes the legacy ID of an asset.

rules.name: Tech Identification
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The technical identifier of the asset

rules.name: Planned Service Life
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The planned remaining life of the asset after the last engineering review.

rules.name: Design Life
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Field Data · e.g. How long the asset is designed to be used.

rules.name: Replacement Cost
rules.note: Stage 2 · Data Requester · Data Entry · e.g. The full replacement cost of the asset.

rules.name: Cost Centre
rules.note: Stage 2 · ADG Team · Data Entry · e.g. The Cost Centre for the asset is provided by Finance

rules.name: Asset Number (Fixed Asset)
rules.note: Stage 2 · ADG Team · Data Entry · e.g. The Asset Number is the number allocated to the Maintainable Asset in the Fixed Asset Register

rules.name: FAR code
rules.note: Stage 2 · ADG Team · Data Entry · e.g. The sub number assigned to the Maintainable Asset in the Fixed Asset Register

rules.name: G2#(S1)

rules.name: G2# (S2)

rules.name: Load Status (S2)
rules.note: Stage 2 · ADG Team · Data Entry · e.g. Feedback from SAP that the asset created correctly.
